home.aboutP1: GraphHelp is an AI-based application designed to analyze handwriting from images uploaded by users. The system uses Artificial Intelligence to deliver analysis results automatically and in an easy-to-understand way.
home.aboutP2: We believe everyone deserves to understand themselves better with the help of technology.
home.quote: GraphHelp is an Artificial Intelligence-based platform that helps analyze handwriting quickly, easily, and efficiently through handwriting pattern recognition technology

step1.title: Prepare your handwriting
step1.desc: Good handwriting is the key to an accurate analysis. Make sure the physical condition of the writing supports AI readability.
dontList: Writing that is too small or too large

step2.title: Quality photo & scan
step2.desc: The AI reads visual details. Make sure the image is:
list: Writing is complete and not cropped

step3.title: Upload & analyze
list: Upload a photo/scan of the writing
Wait for the AI to process (a few seconds)

step4.title: 4. Understanding the Results
step4.tip: Tip: Focus on the main pattern, not just a single indicator. Use it as a tool for self-reflection.

step5.title: 5. Self-Development
step5.intro: Grapholyze is not just an analysis tool, but a means to grow. Use it to:

step6.title: Things to Know
list: Influenced by physical condition while writing.

step7.title: Re-analysis
step7.text: Personality evolves. We recommend re-analyzing after a few months or under different emotional conditions.

vision.title: Vision and Mission
vision.visionText: To become an easy-to-use, informative AI-based handwriting analysis platform that helps users understand the development of motor skills more effectively.
vision.missionText: To develop AI technology that analyzes handwriting automatically, delivers informative results, and supports the monitoring of children's motor development.
